# Clément Balanger — Clemiche Labs

> Freelance product engineer and Flutter tech lead based in Paris, France.
> Ships mobile and web apps to production, with AI features where they
> help. Works on fixed-price engagements, one at a time. French and English.

## Who

- First developer, then mobile tech lead, of a mobility startup's Flutter
  app used daily by 2,500 professional drivers (iOS and Android).
- Co-founder of Diseed (2021–2024), a social app for sharing anecdotes in
  French and Brazilian Portuguese, with LLM features in production
  (content categorisation, translation, image generation).
- Builder of Migrea (migraine tracking app, open beta) and LineUpVote
  (festival group voting).
- Stack: Flutter, Dart, Node.js, TypeScript, Firebase, Supabase,
  PostgreSQL, CI/CD, Claude Code and agent-based development.

## Offers (fixed price, EUR, VAT not applicable)

- Supabase or Firebase security scan: 590 €, 1 week. Access rules (RLS,
  Firestore and Storage rules), auth, exposed keys, ranked findings with
  fixes. Fits apps built quickly or with Lovable, Bolt or FlutterFlow.
- Production-readiness audit: 1,500 €, 2 weeks. Flutter apps or
  prototypes: architecture, performance, security, tests, CI, store
  release, costed recovery plan. Credited against the follow-up work.
- AI feature in your product: 900 € scoping, then integration from
  5,000 €. Model choice, evaluation set, cost per request, production
  integration with written acceptance criteria.
- Also: white-label Flutter subcontracting for agencies; agent-based
  development setup (Claude Code) for developer teams.
